intended_object: A custom projection that tells the `@[simps]` attribute to project a morphism in `SemiRingCat` to its underlying ring homomorphism. I inferred this from the docstring and from the `Hom.Simps.*` naming convention.
explanation: This definition is a technical device with no mathematical counterpart. It is the standard `Simps` projection declaration that sets up how the `@[simps]` attribute generates lemmas for morphisms of `SemiRingCat`. Its body just returns `f.hom`, the underlying ring homomorphism.
